whatIsAPlan.title: What is a plan?
whatIsAPlan.description1: A plan is a timeline of your assets and cash flows that lets you explore different financial futures based on your current situation and the choices you make.
whatIsAPlan.description2: It brings together everything you own or owe - cash, investments, tangible assets and liabilities - alongside the money moving in, out and between them.
whatIsAPlan.description3: You can import your existing financial data as a starting point, then adjust assets and cash flows to fit the specific scenario you want to explore.

details.title: Plan details
details.description: Provide basic information about this plan.

data.title: Financial data
data.description: By default all your current financial data is included to give your plan an accurate starting point.
data.subDescription: You can remove anything that doesn't apply to this plan, and edit any values, settings, or amounts to fit the scenario you want to explore. New assets or cash flows can also be added directly in the plan.

plan.transferMaxDescription: Transfers all available funds at the time of execution
plan.adjustForInflationDescription: Grows the amount each year by the plan's inflation rate, so it keeps its real value over time.
plan.totalExpenseRatioDescription: Annual fund cost. Subtracted from the investment's APY each year — so a 7 % APY with a 1 % TER compounds at 6 %.
plan.entryFeeDescription: Fee charged on money flowing into the investment. Upfront takes it out of the deposit; Ongoing spreads it as an annual drag; 40 / 60 takes 40 % up front and amortizes the rest.
plan.exitFeeDescription: Fee charged when money is taken out of the investment. The source loses the full transfer amount; the destination receives what's left.
plan.interestDescription: Compound interest accrues on prior interest at the chosen frequency; Simple interest accrues only on the outstanding balance. Daily compounding gives the highest effective rate.
plan.insufficientFundsTooltip: Source has insufficient funds in one or more years of this plan.
